title: Bella Poarch Presents The Beaches With the Global Force Award | Billboard Women In Music 2026
summary: Bella Poarch presents The Beaches with Billboard Canada’s Global Force Award at Billboard Women In Music 2026. At the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles on Wednesday night (April 29), Billboard Women in Music 2026 is honoring EJAE, REI AMI, AUDREY NUNA, Kehlani, Teyana Taylor, Ella Langley, Thalia, Zara Larsson, Laufey and Tate McRae.
